notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
Hey friends,

I've just pushed a small update. It contains a bunch of [b]fixes for various bugs and typos[/b].
The main purpose of this build was to lay the groundwork for Steamworks integration. Most importantly: [b]Achivements[/b].

As you can see on the library page, TRACHI now features a whopping number of one (1) achievement. The art and descriptions are [b]placeholders[/b], as I wanted to test its functionality, first. If you want to do so, too, please had over to the [b]Eastern Checkpoint[/b] in the [b]prologue[/b] and show a cat (aka Ve 1st) some appreciation.

In any case, I'll try to have most of the achievements within the [b]main story[/b] implemented sometime tomorrow and push a [b]corresponding build on Sunday[/b], at the latest.

Until then, I hope you have an amazing weekend.

Much love
Nory
